Recorded claim:
IMAP idle does not mean status UI is idle: `FeedbackService.reportStatus()` queues `window.postMessage`. Drain one `TestUtils.waitForTick()` in shared `clearStatusBar()` before checking meteors/progress state. [Task 3]
